title: Halifax & Peggys Cove & Coastal
includes: includes an insured van and driver with commentary.
Does not include meals. They can be purchased in Peggys Cove.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
At time of booking, Cruise ship passengers must provide the following information at time of booking: ship name, docking time, disembarkation time and re-boarding time
policies: Refunds will not be issued if tour/activity is missed due to late or non-arrival of cruise ship
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We operate our tours in a passenger van and provides a small vehicle private tour of Halifax, Peggys Cove and coastal Nova Scotia by a local driver with local knowledge. Limited to six guests.
